verses.21:11: وَكَمۡ قَصَمۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةࣲ كَانَتۡ ظَالِمَةࣰ وَأَنشَأۡنَا بَعۡدَهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

meaning: The root QSM refers to a plant, specifically Artemisia abrotanum, also known as southernwood. There are male (ذَكَرٌ) and female (أُنْثَى) varieties, with the latter referring to santolina.
